mission: Repair the compiled role frontier so a role_ready candidate does not hand a winning worker nonexistent repo-local evidence paths after ownership. Preserve deterministic role identity and external evidence forms, but validate repo-local refs during compilation: resolvable refs remain bounded evidence; missing repo-local refs become explicit machine-readable control-plane diagnostics or suppress an unusable role candidate rather than causing post-claim 404 archaeology. Do not broaden preclaim reads in disposable workers.
